paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.32% on average, with Euro Stoxx 50 strongest (+1.40%) and Hang Seng weakest (-1.32%). Brent crude changed -0.26% to 108.51. Gold changed +0.18% to 4,149.8999. Bitcoin changed +1.80% to 84,437.0. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.109%, a relative move of -0.16%. Among the firms tracked, 3i Group (-3.93%) and Morgan Stanley (+2.40%) moved the most.
